PROJECT BRIEF

What to include in your enquiry

Product and intended use

Tell us about your brand and how you’ll use the product, such as retail packs, complimentary care items or individually wrapped restaurant towels.

Materials and packaging

Share your preferred fabric, sheet size, wipe count and pack format. You can also point us to a catalogue example or item number.

Order and delivery

Include your estimated order quantity, delivery destination and preferred delivery date so we can discuss the schedule.
